# Vibey

> Vibey is an AI operating system for running a business. It gives founders, operators, and teams a crew of specialist AI agents — each with persistent memory, tools, a defined role, and a performance score — that autonomously execute work: marketing campaigns, funnels, ad creatives, email sequences, social content, missions, and more.

Vibey is not a chatbot. It is not a single AI assistant. It is an operating layer where multiple specialist agents collaborate, remember your brand, and execute tasks that produce real outputs: live published funnels, sending email sequences, posted social content, and running ad campaigns.

## Core concepts

- **The Brain** — Three layers of persistent memory (User Brain, Agent Brain, Campaign Knowledge) that compound over time. Agents remember your brand, voice, past decisions, and context across every conversation and campaign.
- **Your Team** — A roster of specialist agents you hire, train, and manage. Each agent has a role (copywriter, analyst, ads manager, etc.), a personality (DISC profile), skills, integrations, and a performance score.
- **Studio** — The primary conversational workspace where you build alongside your agents in real time. Tell them what you want; they build it.
- **Missions** — Structured delegation. Assign multi-step work to agents with plans, subtasks, dependencies, and deliverables. Track progress on a Kanban board.
- **Autopilot** — CEO-level autonomous orchestration. Set a North Star (result, purpose, strategy, off-limits), then close the tab. Vibey creates missions, assigns agents, retries failures, and sends you daily digests.
- **Skills** — Repeatable playbooks you teach agents. The more you teach, the better they get.
- **Capabilities** — Funnels, multi-page websites, email sequences, Meta and Google ads, social publishing, video generation, image creation, presentations, lead capture, CRM contacts, and analytics.
- **Integrations** — 35+ platforms including Meta Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Mailchimp, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Stripe, Calendly, and more.
- **Spaces** — Custom dashboards built with widgets for monitoring campaigns, contacts, and performance.

## Who Vibey is for

- Founders and solo operators who need a full business team without headcount
- Marketing teams who want to delegate execution to AI agents, not just get suggestions
- Agencies managing multiple client campaigns
- E-commerce operators running ads, funnels, and email simultaneously
- SaaS companies that need content, ads, and sequences running continuously

## What makes Vibey different from ChatGPT, Manus, or ClickFunnels

- ChatGPT gives you text. Vibey gives you a team that executes and delivers structured outputs.
- Manus is general computer-use. Vibey is purpose-built for business operations and GTM execution.
- ClickFunnels is a canvas builder. Vibey builds funnels through conversation, with agents that understand your brand.
- Most AI tools are stateless. Vibey's Brain means your agents get smarter and more on-brand over time.
